cases.description: When the section index is greater than the maximum valid index (3), the method should return null.
A large out‑of‑range index also results in null, confirming the upper‑bound check is not dependent on a specific value.
A freshly created Message has no QUESTION records; the string representation of an empty section must be the empty string.
When no ANSWER records are present, sectionToString should return an empty string rather than null.
An empty AUTHORITY section should also produce an empty string.
An empty ADDITIONAL section must return an empty string.
A Message containing a single A record in the ANSWER section should return a string that includes the record's textual representation.
When an MX record is added to the AUTHORITY section, sectionToString must contain the MX record's string form.
An OPT record placed in the ADDITIONAL section should appear in the string returned for section 3.
Passing a negative section index should cause IllegalArgumentException because the internal helper expects a value between 0 and 3.
A large negative index also triggers the same validation, confirming that any i < 0 results in an exception.
